{{Quote|Surrender. It will hurt less.|Dhidal Nyz, to Valin Horn|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
'''Dhidal Nyz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and inventor who specialized in creating imprisonment-related technologies. In [[43 ABY]], he was hired by [[Galactic Alliance Security]] to assist in the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]. He was later hired by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] and partnered with a [[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Valin Horn)|Human bounty hunter]] and the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Vrannin Vaxx]] to capture [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]], who had gone on a destructive rampage after suffering a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. Horn evaded them thanks to the intervention of Skywalker.

Nyz was later hired by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and partnered with [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunter [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] to capture the rogue Jedi [[Seff Hellin]], who suffered from the same disease as Horn. However, Nyz and Kuh lost the bounty to [[Darkmeld]], an organization that Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] formed to counter Daala's [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies.

==Biography==
{{Quote|You shouldn't point weapons at me. It doesn't improve your prospects for survival.|Nyz, to Galactic Alliance Security agents, after he alarmed Bessen into firing at Skywalker|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
Dhidal Nyz was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and inventor, best known for creating various capture&ndash; and imprisonment&ndash;related [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]]. Nyz had made much of his fortune off of his [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]], most of which were high-value fugitives from patents or military contracts.<ref name="Outcast" /> In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]],<ref name="Forums">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=7260#17384444|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Sue Rostoni]]|date=2008-10-02|time=10:48 AM|quote=with FotJ starting at 43.5.}}</ref> he was hired by [[Galactic Alliance Security]], alongside [[Human/Legends|Human]] bounty hunter [[Jesmin Tainer|Zilaash Kuh]] and [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] hunter [[Hrym Mawarr]], to assist in the arrest of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for failing to prevent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo's]] fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. The group was led by Security [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Savar]]. During the arrest in the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]] of the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], ex-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] insulted Savar, who stiffened. Nyz assumed that Skywalker was using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] on Savar and exclaimed that Skywalker was resisting. This caused one of Savar's troopers, [[Bessen]], to lose his nerve and open fire on the Grand Master. His shot missed, and the situation was quickly brought back under control. Savar then took Skywalker to the [[Galactic Alliance Security blockhouse]], though the Grand Master was released soon afterward.<ref name="Outcast" />

[[File:ValinHorn-G6Sketch.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Hired by Chief Daala, Nyz helped capture Valin Horn (pictured).]]
Nyz was later among the several bounty hunters hired by [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]] as part of her [[Daala's special-missions force|special-missions force]] to capture Jedi Knight [[Valin Horn]], who had gone on a destructive rampage through Coruscant after a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. The psychosis caused the affected being to believe that everyone he knew had been replaced by impostors, except for others who suffered from the disease. To capture Horn, Nyz worked with [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] mercenary [[Vrannin Vaxx]] and a[[Unidentified Human bounty hunter (Valin Horn)|Human bounty hunter]]. [[Unidentified pilot (Valin Horn)|Another being]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] Nyz's [[Cargo hauler/Legends|cargo hauler]] during the hunt, and Nyz and his comrades rode in the ship's bed. Meanwhile, as Horn was fleeing from [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] pursuers, the Knight ejected from the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] he had been flying and landed in the bed of the hauler. Jedi Knight [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], who was following Horn in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Kyle Katarn]], was not far behind him. Horn saw her coming and leaped off the edge of the hauler as Solo landed in the cargo bed. Nyz fired his electronic-pulse net gun at Solo, who was caught by the net and knocked backwards off of the hauler, paralyzed by the net's shocks. Another speeder suddenly dove past the hauler, causing its pilot to veer to starboard. The hauler tipped over, and Nyz fell off of the vehicle, though he would survive the fall. Luke Skywalker captured Horn soon thereafter, ending the hunt.<ref name="Outcast" />

Nyz was later hired by the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and partnered with Zilaash Kuh in an attempt to capture the rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Seff Hellin]], who was suffering from the same disease as Horn. Since he believed that Horn was the only being he knew that had not been replaced with an impostor, Hellin [[Raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility|attempted to free him]] from the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on Coruscant in which a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-encased Horn was being held. Hellin failed to free Horn due to the intervention of [[Darkmeld]], an organization that Jaina Solo had formed to counter Daala's [[Anti-Jedi sentiment/Legends|anti-Jedi]] policies, and Hellin's escape from the prison was cut off by Kuh and Nyz. Kuh piloted Nyz's hauler as Nyz shot Hellin, capturing him in an electric net. However, they were quickly intercepted by more Darkmeld members; Solo captured Hellin and escaped with him in a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] with Horn's mother, [[Mirax Terrik Horn]]. In the ensuing chase, Nyz's hauler was ravaged by the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] and Darkmeld affiliate [[Jagged Fel]], who was disguised as a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]], and Kuh and Nyz were forced to forfeit the bounty.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Nice move, fish-head.|A Human bounty hunter to Nyz, after he shot Solo with his net|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
As a bounty hunter, Dhidal Nyz was rather blunt and direct in his speech and dealings. To the dismay of his fellow hunters, he was also often hasty in his actions. However, he had a keen edge for hunting down bounties, and excelled when it came to capture and imprisonment technologies. He was very talented in the uses of such weaponry, as exhibited when he managed to ensnare a Jedi twice with his electric-pulse net.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Electrical shocks.''"<br />"''Interfering with your control over the Force. Which turns you from a Jedi into a rather weak gymnast with a spasming problem.''"<br />"''That's one way to put it.|Jaina Solo and Kyle Katarn, on Nyz's electrical net|<ref name="Outcast" />}}
When hunting, Nyz frequently used the weapons that he invented himself. During the hunt for Valin Horn and Seff Hellin's later raid on the prison, Nyz used a very large gun, which was capable of deploying a net that carried an electrical charge. The net would wrap itself around its quarry, sending paralyzing electrical pulses through the victim every few seconds. This was particularly useful in capturing [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individuals, as the electrical pulses would also interfere with the being's control over the Force. owned a flatbed cargo hauler, which he used in conjunction with other bounty hunters in both the hunt for Horn and the raid on the Armand Isard Correctional Facility.<ref name="Outcast" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nyz was created by author [[Aaron Allston]] for [[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast|''Outcast'']], the first novel of the nine-part ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series, released in [[2009]].<ref name="Outcast" />
